typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Table_TableSpaceSummary_CInstanceName as string,
		TableName as string,
		TableSchema as string,
		TableLastUploaddate as date,
		ETLUser as string,
		Table_TableSpaceSummary_CjoinUploaddate as date,
		TotalSpaceMB as integer,
		Table_TransactDateTable_BjoinUploaddate as date,
		CRowCounts as long,
		RowCountsInMill as long,
		TotalSpaceGB as integer,
		Table_TransactDateTable_BInstanceName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Table_TableSpaceSummary_CInstanceName as string,
		TableName as string,
		TableSchema as string,
		TableLastUploaddate as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		Table_TableSpaceSummary_CjoinUploaddate as string,
		TotalSpaceMB as integer,
		Table_TransactDateTable_BjoinUploaddate as string,
		CRowCounts as long,
		RowCountsInMill as long,
		TotalSpaceGB as integer,
		Table_TransactDateTable_BInstanceName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Table_TableSpaceSummary_CInstanceName,
		TableName,
		TableSchema,
		TableLastUploaddate,
		ETLUser,
		Table_TableSpaceSummary_CjoinUploaddate,
		TotalSpaceMB,
		Table_TransactDateTable_BjoinUploaddate,
		CRowCounts,
		RowCountsInMill,
		TotalSpaceGB,
		Table_TransactDateTable_BInstanceName),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
